UnitStatement: tools/retrieval provides V2 source retrieval for `piping-design` and future DOMAIN packages.
The retrieval layer is a derived local query index over a source database snapshot.
The retrieval layer does not own source truth or copy source files.
The retrieval layer does not require Postgres, a server process, SQLite extensions, LanceDB, DuckDB, Chroma, or cloud services.
The V2 catalog layer uses SQLite `catalog.sqlite` built by `tools/source_catalog/build_source_database.py`.
The V2 lexical layer uses `bm25s` persisted under `<snapshot>/bm25/`.
The V2 embeddings layer uses `fastembed` with `BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5` by default.
The V2 dense storage and search layer uses NumPy `embeddings.npy` and `embeddings_norm.npy` with cosine similarity via dot product.
The V2 alignment layer uses SQLite `index_rows` to map internal row numbers to stable `chunk_id` values.
The public identity for V2 retrieval is `chunk_id` and `artifact_id`, not row numbers.
Historical `tools/retrieval/_index/` artifacts are not part of the V2 contract.
Source database snapshots live under the domain package.
A source database snapshot includes `_LATEST.md`, a `snapshots/SRCIDX_<UTC>/` directory, catalog files, export CSVs, BM25 sidecars, embedding files, metadata, and a QA report.
`catalog.sqlite` is the authoritative derived query catalog for its snapshot.
CSV files in the snapshot are review and export surfaces.
Source files remain in existing filesystem locations and are referenced by relative path plus SHA-256.
Build the source database snapshot with `tools/source_catalog/build_source_database.py --domain-root domains/piping-design`.
For the Chirality self-domain, build from the manifest-referenced governance core corpus.
For the Chirality self-domain, source files are not copied during source database build.
For the Chirality self-domain, catalog paths are recorded as `@repo/<RepoRelPath>` and resolved through `--repo-root`.
The Chirality self-domain source database build uses `--domain-root domains/chirality`, `--repo-root .`, and `--source-manifest domains/chirality/_Sources/Source_Manifest.csv`.
Build BM25 and dense retrieval sidecars into a snapshot with `tools/retrieval/build_source_index.py --snapshot domains/piping-design/_LocalIndexes/_LATEST.md`.
Fixture tests or quick lexical-only builds use `tools/retrieval/build_source_index.py --snapshot <snapshot-or-latest> --no-embeddings`.
For the initial Chirality self-domain milestone, build BM25 only first.
The initial Chirality self-domain BM25-only build uses `tools/retrieval/build_source_index.py --snapshot domains/chirality/_LocalIndexes/_LATEST.md --no-embeddings`.
Dense embeddings may be built later after the catalog and BM25 retrieval path are accepted.
The later dense embedding build for Chirality uses `tools/retrieval/build_source_index.py --snapshot domains/chirality/_LocalIndexes/_LATEST.md` without `--no-embeddings`.
Query retrieval with `tools/retrieval/query_source_index.py`, a snapshot, a query string, and `--k` result count.
Query filters include source document, artifact role, chunk type, audit kind, category ID, knowledge type ID, subject ID, archive state, and JSON output.
The public result contract returns stable IDs and provenance.
Public query results include `chunk_id`, `artifact_id`, `source_doc_id`, `rel_path`, `source_ref`, and `chunk_type`.
Public query results include structural IDs when available.
Public query results include BM25 and dense ranks and scores.
Public query results include a text preview.
Internal row numbers are implementation detail only.
Validate a source database snapshot with `tools/source_catalog/validate_source_database.py --snapshot domains/piping-design/_LocalIndexes/_LATEST.md`.
The Chirality self-domain snapshot validation uses repo-path resolution.
Chirality self-domain validation uses `--snapshot domains/chirality/_LocalIndexes/_LATEST.md`, `--domain-root domains/chirality`, and `--repo-root .`.
`--skip-hash-verify` is available for quick checks over very large local corpora.
Rebuild the source database whenever source files, audit sidecars, or decomposition ledgers change.
Rebuild the retrieval index whenever `Chunks.csv` or `catalog.sqlite` chunks change.
Snapshots are immutable after build.
`_LATEST.md` is the mutable pointer to the current snapshot.
